description: This file is a shell script for download utilities, handling application downloads, URL retrieval, and retry mechanisms within a device management context, specifically for a RDK-based system.

methods.name: tlsLog
methods.description: Logs TLS-related errors to a specified log file.

methods.name: getJSONValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value from a JSON file using jsonquery.

methods.name: getJSONArraySize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of a JSON array.

methods.name: get_core_value
methods.description: Determines the CPU core type of the device, caching and returning the value.

methods.name: downloadApp_getBuildType
methods.description: Determines if the firmware build is VBN, PROD, QA, DEV etc.

methods.name: downloadApp_getVersionPrefix
methods.description: Gets the version prefix based on build type and firmware version.

methods.name: getDownloadUrl
methods.description: Fetches the download URL, possibly from remote sources or default configuration.

methods.name: IsDirectBlocked
methods.description: Checks if direct download is currently blocked based on last failure timestamp.

methods.name: IsCodeBigBlocked
methods.description: Checks if Codebig download is blocked based on last failure timestamp.

methods.name: get_Codebigconfig
methods.description: Retrieves and determines whether to use Codebig for downloads based on device configuration.

methods.name: getCodebigUrl
methods.description: Generates a signed Codebig URL with appropriate authorization headers.

methods.name: generateDownloadUrl
methods.description: Prepares the download URL and associated curl command options.

methods.name: sendDownloadRequest
methods.description: Manages the actual curl request for downloading, with retries on failure.

methods.name: sendAppDownloadRequest
methods.description: Sends application download requests with logging and error handling.

methods.name: applicationDownload
methods.description: Coordinates the process of downloading a package, choosing between direct, Codebig, and fallback retries.

methods.name: applicationExtraction
methods.description: Extracts the downloaded archive and handles errors.

methods.name: is_file_exists
methods.description: Checks for the existence of a file and outputs its basename.
